free_text_notes.physician_note: 77-year-old man with hyperlipidemia, type 2 diabetes, admitted 3/20 with left thalamic infarct with sensory deficits. Deficits stable for 48 hours; passed bedside swallow.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty. A blood sugar reading was briefly elevated on the morning of day 2. The patient's insulin was adjusted slightly and all subsequent readings have been within the target range.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Met with patient and son to review the discharge plan. 3/24 12:45: Son called: car broke down, cannot come today. No alternative ride arranged yet. Discharge paperwork still waiting on the summary.
